learning_objective: 🎯 Let us look up and explore the shiny sun, the changing moon, and the billions of twinkling stars in space!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The sun is actually a huge, extremely hot star! It is at the center of our solar system. The sun gives our planet Earth all the light and warmth we need to live.
The moon doesn't have its own light, it glows by reflecting the sun's light. As it travels around the Earth, it looks like it is changing shapes, from a thin crescent to a big bright full moon!
At night, we can see millions of stars. Sometimes, stars connect like a dot-to-dot puzzle to make pictures in the sky, like a hunter or a bear. These beautiful pictures are called constellations.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Moon Diary!
fun_activity.instructions: Look out your window at the moon every night for one week. Draw its shape in a small notebook to see how it slowly changes over time!

quick_recap: ⭐ The sun is a star that gives us light and heat during the day.
⭐ The moon changes its shape in our sky because it travels around the Earth.
⭐ Constellations are fun patterns and pictures made by stars in the night sky.
